interface.longDescription: Professional, deterministic FFmpeg and FFprobe workflows for ChatGPT and Codex. Inspect media, edit video and audio, convert formats, compose clips and slideshows, diagnose and repair media, plan streaming workflows, and author reusable YAML pipelines. The included Skills prefer the typed @cecilialabs/ffmpeg toolkit when executable tooling is available, with FFprobe preflight, explicit overwrite protection, transactional outputs, structured errors, and optional hardware acceleration. Executable workflows require Node.js 22+ and FFmpeg/FFprobe 6.1+; environments without command execution can still use the plugin to plan commands and author deterministic pipelines.

name: cecilialabs-ffmpeg
